_comment: Everything the setup wizard says out loud, and nothing else. wizard.js shows and speaks these by key; scripts/cache-gen/setup_voice_gen.py turns each into a clip under voice/, and a test fails when a line has none. Change a line here, then re-render.
hero.setup.night: Working late, I see. Shall we bring me online?
hero.setup.morning: Good morning. Shall we bring me online?
hero.setup.afternoon: Good afternoon. Shall we bring me online?
hero.setup.evening: Good evening. Shall we bring me online?
hero.update.night: Working late, I see. There is something new since we last spoke.
hero.update.morning: Good morning. There is something new since we last spoke.
hero.update.afternoon: Good afternoon. There is something new since we last spoke.
hero.update.evening: Good evening. There is something new since we last spoke.
screen.loadout: I have surveyed this machine. Here is what I would recommend.
screen.voice: First, a formality. How would you like me to sound?
screen.events: When would you care to hear from me?
screen.brain: I reason with a small local model. Which one shall I use?
screen.jev: One question I will ask, rather than assume.
screen.presence: Shall I notice when you are here? Whatever I would say to an empty room, I will keep until you return.
screen.phone: Lay your phone face down and my eye stays closed. Face up, and I may look.
screen.phone.nocamera: The phone switch opens and closes my eye. With the camera off, there is nothing to switch.
screen.commit.loading: One moment. I am writing that down.
screen.commit: Nothing has been written yet. Here is precisely what will be.
screen.commit.running: Proceeding. Kindly bear with the progress bars.
audition.voice: Good evening. This is how I would sound, should you keep me.
